Numerical references come from separate computations and retain discretization, boundary and time-step errors and their own resolution sensitivity. They are not exact solutions or guaranteed error bounds. Dimensions follow the source metadata. Taylor–Green has a two-dimensional formula; the existing display is an x-slice at y = π/4.
